single_speed_family: Exact stiffness/friction equivalence at the observed speed; bounds respected; diagnostic only, never used to select the estimator.
equal_budget_rule: Distribute 2000 transitions across original speeds using quotient/remainder in ascending speed order; take each central contiguous window. No duplication or concatenation across speeds.
evaluation: Original unobserved grid speeds are the common primary evaluation set across conditions; all-grid and actually-unobserved error also recorded. Control always uses 13,21,29 m/s.
selection: All observed single speeds and all adjacent pairs; pair identical to full is reused rather than refitted. Average variants within vehicle before vehicle and fleet means; report every variant and worst variant separately.
scope: Small diagnostic on all three reused pilot fleets. Current plant, estimator, common bounds and four starts unchanged. No sharing, new acquisition, model repair or ten-fleet extension.
